r.생활 물가 수준: 54% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Oil, fuels, gas, coal 12%, Footwear 12%, Clothing (woven) 9%, Iron and steel 8%, Electronics, electrical equipment 7% (2024, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 87%, Other electronics, electrical equipment 3%, Precision and medical instruments 2%, Cosmetics 2% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Clothing (woven) 45%, Fish and seafood 14%, Clothing (knit) 13%, Leather shoes 6% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system; until the 1990s it was the most isolated communist state in the world.

t.why: A NATO member and EU candidate.
t.rel: A NATO member, very close to Kosovo, where most residents are ethnic Albanians.
t.know: More than 170,000 bunkers built under communism still dot the country.
t.etext: Tourism and money sent home by people working abroad hold up the economy. Hydropower generates most of its electricity, and it does contract manufacturing of clothing and shoes for Europe. It is reforming its institutions with the goal of joining the EU.
